design.timing: Percentiles of 576 within-state medians from two rotated timing repeats; all repeat timing distribution also exported.
design.bootstrap: 10000 paired resamples of 32 map clusters, seed12345; all states and conditions in each sampled map retained.
design.budget: Hard backup Euler-step cap; equal caps do not imply equal consumed work. Feature/inference runtime is included in planning_ms.
design.source_split: Independent test maps with seed base501000. Training base301000; validation base401000.

model_freeze.work_power_selection: Shared exponent maximizes mean validation recall across geometry learned/hybrid x K12/W3600; exact ties choose smaller exponent.
model_freeze.planned_additional_test: Candidate oracle labels on same576 teststates for heldout classifier metrics; no tuning after freeze.

episodes.margin_interpretation: Collision outcomes cross the configured inflated obstacle boundary. Logged clearance is to the uninflated geometry through the first detected violation.
